The direct market area of the city limits of Fort Worth is primarily comprised of residential land use of varying chronological age, quality
and condition of homes. The area is convenient to major transportation, schools, and recreational facilities. The immediate neighborhood Fort Worth Springs is
made up of similar average to good quality single family site built homes with 10,000sf minimum ot size
Market Conditions (including support for the above conclusions)
12 month market data for comparable properties within the City Limits of Fort Worth
resulted in 19 properties including 1 active listing and 18 closed sales, with an average sales price of $371,000 and average list price of
$375,000. The overall trendline of this data shows appreciation of approximately 8-10% annualized.
